custom_fields.label: Employees may clock themselves in
custom_fields.description: Everyone who clocks themselves in needs a login.

custom_fields.label: Close an open day at the shift's end
custom_fields.description: A forgotten clock-out is marked automatic, not left looking real.

custom_fields.label: Ask why on the way out
custom_fields.description: From Clock Reason. Add your own there.

custom_fields.label: A passkey on their own phone
custom_fields.description: Who. One per employee; a second needs a reset.

custom_fields.label: No passkey refuses the clock-in
custom_fields.description: Off, a missing passkey is only flagged.

custom_fields.label: The network they arrived on
custom_fields.description: The address the request came from, against the places below.

custom_fields.label: Where the browser says they are
custom_fields.description: Needs HRMS geolocation tracking on, and the employee's permission once.

custom_fields.label: Network and place
custom_fields.description: Either is the default: they prove the same thing two ways.

custom_fields.label: Refuse below
custom_fields.description: Out of a hundred. Below this, refused, with the reason shown.

custom_fields.label: Flag below
custom_fields.description: Between the two, written and put in the queue.

custom_fields.label: Ask for a photo
custom_fields.description: A live frame from the camera, never a file. Says who, not where.

custom_fields.label: What the system may learn
custom_fields.description: Only clock-ins corroborated another way teach it anything, and nothing learned widens who may clock in.

custom_fields.label: Learn a new office address
custom_fields.description: A router reboot stops locking everybody out on a Monday.

custom_fields.label: Learn where people actually stand
custom_fields.description: A gate two hundred metres from the door becomes a second circle.

custom_fields.label: Learn home networks and home zones
custom_fields.description: For remote workers. Off by default.

custom_fields.label: Proposals need
custom_fields.description: How many people, and how many clock-ins, before it confirms itself.
